children: Alector entered into an Underwriting Agreement with Morgan Stanley and BTIG for a public offering of 36,600,000 shares of common stock at $2.05 per share. Gross proceeds are expected to be approximately $75.03 million before fees and expenses. The offering, made off an effective shelf registration, is expected to close on Oct 19, 2026, subject to customary conditions.
